messages.subject: problem in rendering of selectizeInput (urgent)
parts:
Hey Guys

I am trying to use selectizeInput in shiny but for some reason I don't see the options list render correctly. See attached image.
Only single option is visible which is also partially hidden. based on the examples I was expecting to see few options and scroll bar. Also this is not browser specific I tried it Chrome, safari and firefox.

Also including the basic ui.R code..

using Shiny  v0.10.1

Thanks!
-Abhi


library(shiny)

shinyUI( navbarPage("Synodos Data Explorer", id="nav",
  
  tabPanel("Public Data",
           # Application title
           titlePanel("Explore Public Datasets"),           
           h4('Select a Pathway Group'),
          
           h4('Options'),
           selectInput('pathways', 'Pathways', choices = rownames(BioCarta), 
                          multiple=TRUE, width='400px',selectize=F)
           
  ), #END TabPanel("Public Data")
    
  tabPanel("Kinome Screens",
           titlePanel("Exploring Kinome Screening Data")
           
  )#END Kinome Screen panel
  
) #END navbar
) #END ShinyUI

messages.subject: Re: problem in rendering of selectizeInput (urgent)
parts:
Hi Abhi,

This works for me:

library(shiny)
runApp(list(
  ui = navbarPage("Synodos Data Explorer", id="nav",

tabPanel("Public Data",
                           # Application title
                           titlePanel("Explore Public Datasets"),          
                           h4('Select a Pathway Group'),
                          
                           h4('Options'),

multiple=TRUE, width='400px',selectize=F)
                          
                  ), #END TabPanel("Public Data")
                  tabPanel("Kinome Screens",
                  titlePanel("Exploring Kinome Screening Data")
                  ) #END Kinome Screen panel

), #END navbar
 
  server = function(input,output,session)
    {
   
  })
)

I have only replaced rownames(BioCarta) by state.name. Thus, it seems there might be an issue with your rownames(BioCarta). Are you sure it has more than 1 rowname?

Carlos
